    • sidebarHeader

      public Tabs.Builder sidebarHeader(PanelElement... elements)
      Elements above the sidebar's tab column (a Back button, say), positioned from the column's top-left and laid out to its width the way a panel lays out its own elements. The column widens to fit them, within its cap; the body beside it still starts at the top (under header, when there is one). Tabs.Mode.SIDEBAR only.

    • header

      public Tabs.Builder header(PanelElement... elements)
      Elements in a row across the whole element, above the strip (or the sidebar column) and the body, in every mode: a menu's title bar. Positioned from the element's top-left and laid out to its full width the way a panel lays out its own elements, so a Flow with a spacer at each end centres a label across it. The strip, the column and the body start under it and Tabs.HEADER_GAP; the body is that much shorter. Hidden elements keep no room. A screen whose header names it can hideTitle() so the name shows once.
